firstPlayerRule: The previous game's winner starts, or choose whoever delivers the most expressive cry of “Braaaaains!”.
houseFallback: If neither option settles the choice, or your group prefers another approach, agree to choose randomly. This is this site's suggested house rule.
clarifications: These are alternative starting criteria; the manual does not present the vocal performance as a tie-break after a tied win.
The extra round for tied leaders resolves the end of the game. It is not an initial-start tie-break.
This answer covers the base game's version 1.0 rules.
